built: workbench/mind_panel_qt.py (new): one panel in her column for a card, with Why, Rests on, Either way and What would settle it. Why shows reasons.why's lines (at most 12) with each line's state word and where it came from, then For and Against, ending with what would change it. Clicking a line selects that card and lights the proof's wires with FieldView.light_proof; the selection steps the rest of the desk back. Next and Back walk the proof from the source end and light the wires as far as the walk has reached; the walk row sits above the proof so it can be reached without scrolling. Rests on shows field.rests: the answer that counts, her proposal marked 'mine, not agreed', and Without it and With <other revision> instead buttons. Either way shows field.either, with one button per value when one choice decides; pressing a button selects that revision's sheet. What would settle it shows field.settle and her next step. All four are reads, the panel writes nothing, and the foot says 'Model calls: 0'. Every text goes through model_words.plain_only, then shell2.leaded in Kasandra. Its WORDS are registered with mind_words. The chosen line has a rule at its left and the shown section has a '›' mark. show_why(host, card) replaces the panel shown before and scrolls her column to the panel's head.

workbench/field_source.py: Reader.mind(), read after settle_tables, through observer reads only (goals.list, goals.check, word.list, rules.list, rules.check, quotes.list). Goal cards: kept relation goals, with the state judged over every revision or under your CHOICE word, and the room or each way's result as facts. They are wired from the sheets and rows they read, with one wire per sheet labelled 'rows 2, 3', and from their calculation ('its result'). Rule cards: titled as rules.py's question, with the conclusion and the fixed footer as facts. A row is a wire from its sheet. A pinned quote is a wire from the admitted file its words stand on, labelled with the quote's labels ('§ 12(a), § 12(b), § 12(c)'), drawn for a recheck when the quote is not CURRENT. Quotes are never cards. Word cards: CURRENT or recheck (RECONSIDER). Wired from the rows they are bound to, to the goal they decide ('decides'), and from a READING word to every rule card resting on that row ('how it reads').
workbench/activity.py: goals.list, goals.get and goals.check added to OBSERVER_OPERATIONS, so showing goal cards is not an event.

workbench/demo_try.py (new): Guide ▸ Try Rail Demo and Try Home Demo. Her card in her column comes first: invented data, built in a new folder ~/Graphite demos/<name> <date time> with its own profile and Concern folder, never in your workspace or profile, and it opens in a window of its own. Nothing is built until Build it is pressed. The build runs as `python -m workbench.demo_try rail|home FOLDER` in a process of its own, using rail_demo.workspace or home_demo.workspace (the Kernel's own doors) and keeping the desk's proposed goals with goals.keep. Then it starts `python -m workbench.launch` with that folder's workspace, profile and Concern and the current look; that window opens on the Field (open_on_work). Its words are registered with mind_words.

decisions_where_plan_silent: The demos open in a separate Graphite window process with their own profile and Concern, not in the owner's window. rail_demo.workspace and home_demo.workspace repoint the process's profile and locations, so building in the owner's process could reach his profile. The owner's window is left as it was.
Try Rail Demo and Try Home Demo keep the desk's proposed goals (goals.keep, given by the owner's Build it press) so goal cards appear on the demo. rail_demo.py and home_demo.py were not changed.

Goal cards show only kept goals (records), never her candidates, because her proposals stay words, not records. A goal card's state is goals.check over every revision, or under the owner's CHOICE word when one applies, so it agrees with Either way ('holds' when both revisions hold, 'depends' when they differ). Why on the same goal follows reasons.py, which with no word gives 'cannot tell' plus 'It would hold if you agree ...'.
goals.list, goals.get and goals.check became observer operations so the Field's goal cards do not add timeline events (each is a read).
'Why' appears only on the work face. The apps and network faces are not desk records, and reasons.py cannot read them.
Added 'An Evening with Kas's Mind' to the Guide menu so the Guide page can be opened from the window.
